paragraphs.text:
After such a close call, you know you must lead the students 
from this valley. But for the expedition’s sake, you will make one 
more attempt to find physical proof.

To head into the hills, go to 621. To persist with the beasts of the 
meadowland, go to 620. To scout in pairs, go to 609.
